::: {#def-simulation-bias-estimate}
#### Simulation estimate of the bias

For an [estimand](estimation.qmd#def-estimand) $\param$ and an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) $\hparam$,
the **simulation estimate of the [bias](estimation.qmd#def-bias)** of $\hparam$
is the [simulation estimate](#def-simulation-estimate) of $\E{\hparam}$, minus $\param$:

$$\samplemean{T}{M} - \param.$$
:::
